name: Microsoft Graph (Microsoft 365)
summary: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID tenant data through Microsoft Graph: users, groups and members, licence subscriptions and assignments, Microsoft 365 activity reports and sign-in logs.

client_id.description: Application (client) id of an Entra ID app registration.

client_secret.description: A client secret of that app registration (web/confidential client).

refresh_token.description: A refresh token from the authorization code flow, requested with offline_access and the Graph permissions the calls need (User.Read.All, GroupMember.Read.All, LicenseAssignment.Read.All, Reports.Read.All, AuditLog.Read.All).

notes: Calls act as the signed-in user behind the refresh token (delegated permissions): besides the app's consented Graph permissions, that user needs an Entra role that can read the data (e.g. Global Reader or Reports Reader for reports and sign-ins).
Lists page with @odata.nextLink: call that full URL for the next page; $skip is not supported on directory objects.
Advanced queries ($search, $count, most $filter/$orderby on users, groups and members) need the ConsistencyLevel: eventual header and $count=true.
Usage reports answer 302 to a short-lived pre-signed CSV download, not JSON.
Throttled requests get 429 with a Retry-After header.

endpoints.name: List users
endpoints.summary: Users in the tenant with name, mail, job title and any $select-ed properties.

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. startswith(displayName,'a') or accountEnabled eq true.

search.description: Quoted property:text search, e.g. "displayName:anna". Needs ConsistencyLevel: eventual and $count=true.

count.description: true to include @odata.count; needed with $search and advanced filters.

consistency_level.description: eventual; required with $search, $count and advanced $filter/$orderby queries.

endpoints.name: Get a user
endpoints.summary: One user's profile by object id or userPrincipalName.

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

endpoints.name: List a user's licences
endpoints.summary: Licence SKUs and service plans assigned to a user, directly or through groups.

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

endpoints.name: List groups
endpoints.summary: Groups in the tenant (Microsoft 365, security, distribution).

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. startswith(displayName,'a') or accountEnabled eq true.

search.description: Quoted property:text search, e.g. "displayName:anna". Needs ConsistencyLevel: eventual and $count=true.

count.description: true to include @odata.count; needed with $search and advanced filters.

consistency_level.description: eventual; required with $search, $count and advanced $filter/$orderby queries.

endpoints.name: List group members
endpoints.summary: Direct members of a group (users, devices, contacts, groups).

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. startswith(displayName,'a') or accountEnabled eq true.

search.description: Quoted property:text search, e.g. "displayName:anna". Needs ConsistencyLevel: eventual and $count=true.

count.description: true to include @odata.count; needed with $search and advanced filters.

consistency_level.description: eventual; required with $search, $count and advanced $filter/$orderby queries.

notes: Not transitive: nested groups' members are not expanded.

endpoints.name: List licence subscriptions
endpoints.summary: The tenant's commercial subscriptions with enabled, consumed and suspended units per SKU.

select.description: Comma-separated properties to return; defaults to a small set.

endpoints.name: Get Microsoft 365 active user detail
endpoints.summary: Per-user licence flags and last activity dates for Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Yammer, as CSV.
notes: Answers 302 to a pre-signed CSV URL valid for a few minutes. Needs Reports.Read.All.

endpoints.name: List sign-ins
endpoints.summary: Entra ID sign-in events, newest first, with user, app, IP, location, device and status.

filter.description: OData filter; give a time range to avoid timeouts, e.g. createdDateTime ge 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z.

notes: Only events within Entra ID's retention period are available. Needs AuditLog.Read.All.
